title: The Complete Drop Randomizer, Shuffler & Multiplier
description: Randomised drops with auto-reshuffle and multiplied quantities. No rare bonus - just chaos and quantity.
body:
# The Complete Drop Randomizer, Shuffler & Multiplier

Randomised drops, multiplied quantities, and an automatic reshuffle timer - without the rare bonus. The drops never stop changing and you're always getting more of whatever they are.

## Features
- **1000+ blocks** all have randomized drops
- **Mob drops** are randomized too
- **Fishing** drops are randomized too
- **256 possible drop configurations** - reshuffled automatically on a timer
- **x4, x16, x64** multiplier tiers - switch any time
- **Bossbar countdown** visible to all players at all times
- Works in survival, no cheats required

## How to use
1. Install the datapack
2. Load your world
3. Start breaking things
4. Run `/function autoshuffle:set_1min`, `/function autoshuffle:set_5min` or `/function autoshuffle:set_10min` to set the interval
5. Run `/function randomizer:set_x4`, `/function randomizer:set_x16` or `/function randomizer:set_x64` to change the multiplier

## Notes
- Compatible with Minecraft 26.1.2
- Pure datapack - no mods, no executables

If you make a video using this datapack, a credit or link back to this page would be appreciated!
